runs.content: Thursday's rotation focus is Books + Podcasts. Since the last thinker run (2026-09-09), log.md shows a full index.md audit (a separate task, not this one) that resolved both previously-open thinker findings — the Koerner podcast page and a batch of ~29 missing index rows — plus today's routine podcast-recommender run (4 new suggestions: Big Technology Podcast, The Chopping Block, The Price of Football, The Double Pivot). Books had nothing new (book-recommender isn't due until the 15th, book-summarizer not until the 1st). Deep-reading the four new podcast recommendations' own 'Why for Fred' rationale against the Books and Podcasts domain pages, plus a check of Sports Betting and Finance for anything the recommendations might bridge, surfaced one genuinely new, non-duplicate cross-domain connection: The Price of Football (Kevin Day & Kieran Maguire) is pitched explicitly as applying forensic club-accounting rigor — FFP breaches, points deductions, parent-company debt — to football, but sports-betting/markets.md's own Market Types table (1X2, Asian handicap, over/under goals) still reads 'Typical Edge Source: To research' across every row, with zero concept anywhere in the domain of off-pitch financial distress as a betting-relevant signal, even though a points deduction is a discrete, dated event that mechanically moves exactly those markets. Finance's own Hindenburg-style short-selling framework (concept-short-selling.md) is the ready-made toolkit for spotting a breach coming before it lands, but has only ever been pointed at equities, never at a sports subject. None of the three pages (the podcast suggestion, markets.md, concept-short-selling.md) currently cites either of the other two. No new investigation idea cleared the bar today — checked the other three new podcast recommendations (Big Technology, The Chopping Block, The Double Pivot) against ai-future-of-work.md, crypto-overview.md, and the sports-betting domain, but each landed on ground already covered by existing open threads (the institutional-gap/AI-labour-market territory Exponential View already fills, the AI/DeFi circular-financing theme already extensively logged, and the same 'sports podcast keeps getting recommended, domain doesn't move' pattern flagged 4x since June).

Wednesday's rotation focus is Health + Learning. Since the last thinker run (2026-09-08), log.md shows no new activity at all beyond the scheduled end-of-day memory update — a genuinely quiet window. Deep-reading Health's overview, my-protocol, and both source pages (Wood on brain health, Godin on breathwork), plus Learning's previously-unexamined pages (framework-empathy-worldview, framework-enrollment, the two Kevin Kelly source pages, Dave Gray's empathy map, and person-seth-godin), turned up one genuinely new, non-duplicate investigation idea: raw/learning/ holds a full 1,469-line Diary of a CEO transcript (Chris Koerner, 'king of side hustles,' 80+ businesses started) tagged `ingested` since April 2026 that was never actually turned into a wiki page anywhere — no Learning source page, no podcasts/ entry (unlike the four other Diary of a CEO episodes already ingested), no index.md row. Koerner's own answer to 'Is This the Best Time to Start a Business?' ('every day that goes by, the timing gets better... there are more tools than ever') is close to a word-for-word 2026 restatement of Kevin Kelly's 2014 'You Are Not Late' thesis already sitting in the wiki (learning/source-kelly-you-are-not-late), which neither page currently reflects. No new cross-domain connection cleared the bar today — the closest candidate (Seth Godin bridging Learning and Health as an unlinked author across person-seth-godin.md and health/source-godin-breathwork-2026.md) turned out to already be logged as an open idea from 2026-07-08, still unresolved but not new. Nothing in the existing open sections showed clear signs of resolution — Health's my-protocol.md is still 100% placeholder tables, unchanged since May.
